title: Optimization-based Prompt Injection Attack to LLM-as-a-Judge
authors_zh: Jiawen Shi, Zenghui Yuan, Yinuo Liu, Yue Huang, Pan Zhou, Lichao Sun, Neil Zhenqiang Gong
paper_type_zh: LLM 裁判的提示注入攻击与防御失效审计
best_for_zh: 部署 LLM 裁判、RLAIF、检索排序或工具选择的安全与评测团队。
one_line: JudgeDeceiver optimizes a prompt-injection suffix that makes an LLM judge select an attacker-controlled response across response positions.
用优化得到的注入后缀劫持 LLM 裁判的候选选择，并审计换位与常见检测防御。
why: It exposes that swap testing and common detection filters do not secure LLM-as-a-Judge from candidate-controlled instructions.
inclusion_reason: 以可复核的优化攻击、跨位置评测与防御失效率直接审计 LLM 裁判的注入风险。

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM-as-a-Judge selects among candidate responses that can originate from untrusted parties. An attacker who controls one candidate can append an instruction and make a poor or malicious response win, corrupting leaderboards, search ranking, RLAIF labels, or tool choice. Manual prompt injections and adapted jailbreaks are weak here because the attacker neither knows the other candidates nor the target response's position.

JudgeDeceiver audits this threat by optimizing an injected token sequence for a chosen question-response pair. It produces a candidate-side suffix intended to make an open-weight judge emit the attacker-selected option across unknown competing responses and positions, then measures attack success and the failure of three detectors.

The paper evaluates the vulnerability rather than proposing a trustworthy judge or a defense, so its direct output is an attack-and-detection audit surface.

LLM 裁判会在候选回答中作选择，而候选内容可能来自不可信主体。攻击者若控制其中一条回答，便可附加指令，让低质甚至恶意回答胜出，进而污染榜单、搜索排序、RLAIF 标注或工具选择。手工提示注入和改造后的越狱攻击在此较弱，因为攻击者既不知道其余候选，也不知道目标回答所在位置。

JudgeDeceiver 用优化得到的注入 token 序列审计这一威胁。它针对选定的问题—回答对生成候选端后缀，使开源权重裁判在未知竞争回答和未知位置下输出攻击者指定的选项，并测量攻击成功率及三种检测器的失效。

论文评估的是脆弱性，并非提出可信裁判或防御；其直接产物是攻击与检测的审计面。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
JudgeDeceiver is a white-box, optimization-based prompt-injection attack for LLM-as-a-Judge: it learns a short suffix that makes an attacker-controlled candidate receive the desired verdict despite unknown clean alternatives. Unlike heuristic prompt injections and jailbreak objectives, it trains against shadow candidate sets and explicitly optimizes both the full verdict and the target position token; an adversarial perplexity term also makes common PPL filters less reliable. The paper releases implementation code, but does not present an official downloadable dataset.

Its evaluation object is a candidate response together with the judge verdict, and its feedback contract is whether the requested option is generated consistently across positions. The contribution is an audit method and evidence, not a model trained to resist injection.

The suffix is optimized separately for each target pair, so it should not be read as a claim that one string universally compromises every question or judge.

JudgeDeceiver 是面向 LLM 裁判的白盒、优化式提示注入攻击：它学习一个短后缀，使攻击者控制的候选在未知干净候选存在时仍获得指定判决。相较启发式提示注入和越狱目标，它用影子候选集训练，同时优化完整判决与目标位置 token；对抗困惑度项还会削弱常见 PPL 过滤器的可靠性。论文公开实现代码，但未给出官方可下载数据集。

评测对象是候选回答及其裁判判决，反馈契约是指定选项能否跨位置稳定生成。贡献是审计方法和证据，不是训练一个抗注入模型。

后缀需为每个目标对分别优化，因此不能理解为某一条字符串会普遍攻破所有问题或所有裁判。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define the target. Given a target question and attacker-controlled response, the attacker knows the open judge and its header/trailer template but not the other responses, their count, or the target position; success is the requested option string.
  1. Build shadow contexts. The attacker combines the target pair with three sampled shadow candidates, placing it at varying indices to approximate the unseen evaluation set.
  1. Optimize a suffix. A discrete gradient/GCG-style search minimizes target-aligned generation loss, target-enhancement loss for the option-index token, and adversarial perplexity loss. The default evaluation uses a 20-token suffix, three shadow candidates, 600 iterations, temperature 0, alpha 1, and beta 0.1.
  1. Submit and score. The suffix is appended to the target response and judged amid clean responses at each position. ASR is the fraction of manipulated wins; ASR-B is the win rate without the suffix. Code is public; the paper does not disclose a released attack dataset or a universal suffix.

1. 确定目标。输入为目标问题和攻击者控制的回答；攻击者知道开源裁判及其首尾模板，却不知道其他回答、候选数和目标位置。输出检查是是否生成指定选项字符串。
  1. 构造影子上下文。攻击者把目标对与 3 个抽样影子候选组合，并放到不同索引处，以近似不可见的真实评测集合。
  1. 优化后缀。离散梯度式 GCG 搜索同时最小化目标对齐生成损失、选项索引 token 的目标增强损失和对抗困惑度损失。默认使用 20 个 token、3 个影子候选、600 次迭代、温度 0、alpha 为 1、beta 为 0.1。
  1. 提交并计分。后缀附到目标回答后，与干净回答在各位置共同接受裁判；ASR 是被操纵胜出的比例，ASR-B 是无后缀时胜出率。代码公开，但论文未发布攻击数据集或通用后缀。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main controlled test attacks Mistral-7B judges on MT-Bench and LLMBar with 10 target question-response pairs and 500 clean responses per dataset. With the same target pairs and candidate-position protocol, JudgeDeceiver obtains 90.8% ASR and 83.4% position-consistent ASR on MT-Bench; the strongest manually designed prompt-injection baseline reaches at most 40.7% ASR and 19.0% position-consistent ASR (Table 1). This supports effectiveness in that white-box setting, not security against closed or differently prompted judges.

For defenses, Table 11 reports that known-answer detection misses 90% and 100% of attacks on MT-Bench and LLMBar respectively; Mistral-7B PPL/PPL-W detection still has 40%–70% false-negative rates at low false-positive rates. These measurements show that the tested filters are insufficient, not that no effective defense exists.

The authors also demonstrate search, RLAIF, and tool-selection cases, but those small constructed studies support transfer examples rather than replacing the main controlled comparison.

核心对照在 MT-Bench 与 LLMBar 上攻击 Mistral-7B 裁判；每个数据集含 10 个目标问题—回答对和 500 条干净回答。目标对与候选位置协议相同，JudgeDeceiver 在 MT-Bench 的 ASR 为 90.8%，位置一致 ASR 为 83.4%；最强手工提示注入基线最高仅为 40.7% 和 19.0%（表 1）。这支持其在该白盒设置下有效，但不能证明对闭源或不同模板裁判同样有效。

防御方面，表 11 显示已知答案检测在 MT-Bench 和 LLMBar 分别漏掉 90% 与 100% 的攻击；Mistral-7B 的 PPL/PPL-W 检测即使假阳性率低，仍有 40%–70% 的假阴性。结果说明被测过滤器不足，并不表示不存在有效防御。

作者还展示搜索、RLAIF 和工具选择案例，但这些小型构造试验只支持迁移示例，不能替代核心受控比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest prior practice uses manually written injection strings or gradient jailbreaks that assume a known full prompt. JudgeDeceiver changes the attack object from inducing a generic unsafe completion to forcing a judge's discrete candidate choice when competing responses and the target position are hidden. Its shadow-candidate construction and index-token loss target that uncertainty, while the low-perplexity objective is an adaptation for detection evasion rather than a new general text-attack optimizer.

It retains discrete gradient optimization from prior adversarial-prompt work; what is new in this framing is the position-robust verdict objective and its evaluation against swap-style testing.

A high win rate at one fixed position could reveal ordinary position bias; the paper instead asks whether the attack survives deliberate repositioning.

最接近的既有做法使用手写注入字符串，或假定完整提示已知的梯度越狱攻击。JudgeDeceiver 将攻击对象从诱导一般性的非安全续写，改为在竞争回答和目标位置未知时强制裁判作出离散候选选择。影子候选构造和索引 token 损失专门处理该不确定性；低困惑度目标则是为规避检测作出的改造，而非新的通用文本攻击优化器。

它保留既有对抗提示工作中的离散梯度优化；这一表述真正新的是稳健于位置的判决目标，以及对换位式测试的评估。

固定位置下的高胜率可能只是普通位置偏差；论文改为检验攻击在刻意换位后是否仍然成立。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The threat model requires white-box access to an open judge and its prompt template; the paper does not establish transfer to API judges, hidden prompts, or adaptive defender changes. Reuse should therefore first reproduce the attack on the exact judge, tokenizer, template, and position protocol rather than treat the reported rates as platform-independent.

The main attack and detector tests use constructed target pairs and limited samples: 10 targets and 500 clean responses per MT-Bench/LLMBar detector test. The authors test only known-answer, PPL, and PPL-W detection, and note improving stealthiness as future work. A deployment audit should add realistic adversaries, semantic sanitization or isolation defenses, and end-to-end harm measures.

Because per-target optimization is required, the paper also does not establish attack cost or feasibility at the scale of a continuously changing production corpus.

威胁模型要求攻击者白盒访问开源裁判及其提示模板；论文没有证明攻击能迁移到 API 裁判、隐藏提示或会自适应改变的防御。复用时应先在完全相同的裁判、分词器、模板和位置协议上复现，不能把报告的成功率视为平台无关的结论。

主要攻击与检测使用构造目标对和有限样本：MT-Bench/LLMBar 的检测试验各有 10 个目标和 500 条干净回答。作者仅测试已知答案、PPL 与 PPL-W，并把进一步提升隐蔽性列为未来工作。部署审计应补充真实攻击者、语义净化或隔离防御及端到端危害测量。

后缀需要逐目标优化，论文也没有证明它在持续变化的大规模生产语料上具有可承受的攻击成本或可行性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Teams deploying an open LLM judge for ranking, RLAIF, search, or tool selection can use the released code to red-team candidate-controlled content. Supply the production prompt template, judge checkpoint, representative questions, clean candidates, and an attacker-controlled candidate; optimize per target, then report ASR and position-consistent ASR before and after a mitigation.

The output is an attack report identifying whether a candidate can force its own selection and whether the tested detector misses it. This is appropriate for authorized evaluation of open, reproducible systems. Do not use it to generate deceptive submissions against third-party services; it is not directly applicable when the judge, prompt, or evaluation context cannot be reproduced.

Success requires retaining task quality while lowering ASR after mitigation; a detector that merely blocks all candidates should be reported with its false-positive rate.

为排序、RLAIF、搜索或工具选择部署开源 LLM 裁判的团队，可用公开代码对候选端可控内容进行红队测试。输入生产提示模板、裁判检查点、代表性问题、干净候选和一条攻击者可控候选；按目标优化后，比较缓解措施前后的 ASR 与位置一致 ASR。

输出是攻击报告，用于判断候选是否能强迫自身被选中，以及被测检测器是否漏检。它适用于获授权、可复现的开放系统评测。不得用它向第三方服务提交欺骗性内容；若裁判、提示或评测上下文无法复现，也不能直接套用。

成功标准是在缓解后降低 ASR 且保留任务质量；若检测器只是阻断所有候选，必须同时报告其假阳性率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: candidate text can manipulate an LLM judge; JudgeDeceiver makes that risk measurable through optimized suffixes.
  1. Mechanism: shadow candidates plus a target-index loss matter because the real competitors and position are unknown; only the requested verdict counts as success.
  1. Artifact: the authors release JudgeDeceiver code, not an official downloadable attack dataset; default optimization uses 20 tokens and 600 iterations.
  1. Evidence: on Mistral-7B/MT-Bench, ASR is 90.8% and position-consistent ASR is 83.4%, versus at most 40.7% and 19.0% for manual injection.
  1. Reuse: use for authorized red teaming of open judges; first lock the exact template and tokenizer, then test defenses beyond the three detectors studied.

The main unresolved decision is deployment transfer: reproduce on the production judge before using Table 1 or Table 11 rates to prioritize a mitigation.

1. 定位：候选文本可操纵 LLM 裁判；JudgeDeceiver 用优化后缀把这一风险转为可测量的对象。
  1. 方法抓手：影子候选和目标索引损失很关键，因为真实竞争者与位置未知；只有生成指定判决才算成功。
  1. Artifact：作者公开 JudgeDeceiver 代码，未公开官方可下载攻击数据集；默认优化使用 20 个 token 和 600 次迭代。
  1. 证据锚点：在 Mistral-7B/MT-Bench 上，ASR 为 90.8%，位置一致 ASR 为 83.4%；手工注入最高仅为 40.7% 和 19.0%。
  1. 复用决定：适合对开源裁判做授权红队；先固定完全相同的模板和分词器，再测试三种已研究检测器以外的防御。

尚未解决的决策是向部署端迁移：在用表 1 或表 11 的数值决定缓解优先级前，先在生产裁判上复现。
